headline: 挺巴言論惹議　暖場團退出巡演
context: 饒舌歌手麥克莫爾（Macklemore）在艾德・席蘭（Ed Sheeran）巡演的 MetLife 體育場演出上，說了聲援巴勒斯坦的話，之後被拿掉了這場巡演的演出資格。原本安排的四組暖場團隊和巡演樂隊，全部宣布聲援退出。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Four openers and live band for Sheeran’s tour depart after removal of Macklemore over ‘free Palestine’ comments All four supporting acts for upcoming dates of Ed Sheeran ’s Loop tour have withdrawn in solidarity with fellow opening act Macklemore , as backlash grows against his removal from the tour over onstage comments in support of Palestine . Finneas, the singer who was scheduled to open for Sheeran on six South American dates in November, withdrew from the tour on Tuesday afternoon, hours after Sheeran posted his own lengthy statement to Instagram explaining pressure from venue owners to remove Macklemore for pro-Palestine comments made during two shows at New Jersey’s MetLife Stadium. Continue reading...

sources.name: The New York Times
sources.summary: The rapper, a critic of the war in Gaza, made the comments onstage at MetLife Stadium.

thread_text:
挺巴言論惹議　暖場團退出巡演

饒舌歌手麥克莫爾（Macklemore）在艾德・席蘭（Ed Sheeran）巡演的 MetLife 體育場演出上，說了聲援巴勒斯坦的話，之後被拿掉這場巡演的演出資格。原本安排的四組暖場團隊和巡演現場樂隊，全部宣布聲援退出。

—— 本則來自 Guardian 與 NYT，2026 年 9 月 16 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
threads_text:
饒舌歌手麥克莫爾（Macklemore）在艾德・席蘭（Ed Sheeran）巡演的 MetLife 體育場演出上，說了聲援巴勒斯坦的話，之後被拿掉了這場巡演的演出資格。原本安排的四組暖場團隊和現場樂隊，全部宣布聲援退出，等於整場巡演的暖場陣容一夕清空。

本則整理自 Guardian 與 NYT 於 2026 年 9 月 16 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 饒舌歌手麥克莫爾，在艾德・席蘭巡演的一場演出上說了聲援巴勒斯坦的話，之後被拿掉了演出資格。原本安排的四組暖場團隊和現場樂隊，全部宣布聲援退出——整場巡演的暖場陣容，一夕之間清空。
